files: One ZIP andCHECKSUM per date. GET only, no auth/redirects; body<=3MB,ZIPuncompressed<=10MB singleCSV.
resumption: OS lock; immutable per-file body+metadata+SHA; day checkpoint after validation. Partial day resumes missing checksum only; orphan body without metadata fails closed, no invented ingestion. Stop at budget, leave checkpoint.
errors: 404/410 date missing retained;403/451 access block stops no bypass;429 and network failures stop with finite next-retry delay; validation/hash errors stop/quarantine original bytes. No repeated busy retry.
quality: Record NaN/blank fields, raw order/duplicate labels and sorted UTC-assumed daily5min grid. Original labels/units preserved; sorted inspection only, available_at unknown. Full historical publication/stock unit certification pending.
prohibitions: No conditional PnL, candidate generation, paid sources, account calls or OKX execution substitution
